_comment: Every client that gets its own installable build. This is the single list
the release workflows fan out over, so adding a school here is all it takes
for the next release to include them — no branch, no config file.
'default' is the public build. It keeps the landing page and becomes
/releases/latest, which is what an unbranded download gets.
'id' must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It becomes:
- the <meta name="client-id"> baked into that build's HTML
- the releaseFilter its installed copy updates from
Colours, logo and school name do NOT belong here — a school's admin sets
those from Settings > School Branding and they load from the database.
